verdict.rationale: Viam's docs say outright that the fleet management API lets you manage a fleet with code "the same way you can do in the web UI". APIs and the CLI also cover machine control (any method a machine serves), data query/export/tagging, and ML training jobs, and an agent can operate a machine "the same way a person or a program can". However, onboarding docs walk through creating machines and writing inline modules in the browser app without showing API equivalents. Missing for 10: explicit API parity for UI-only flows (machine-creation wizard, inline module editor, test panels/Teleop dashboards), a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI probes 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of full parity.
